strace_command: IDLE_STRACE=bench/idle-profile-corrected.strace nix develop . --command python3 bench/idle_profile.py TERMINAL WESTON SEAT

observations.interpretation: The corrected trace targets the actual terminal PID. PTY fd 3 shows 12 poll calls with a 100 ms timeout, consistent with the PtyWaiter loop. Wayland socket polls account for the remaining terminal-thread waits. ptrace_stop samples are tracing artifacts, not application waits. This measures syscall timeout calls, not scheduler wakeups.
